title: 98-02 Camaro Wilwood DynaPro Radial Front Drag Brake Kit
description:
Upgrade the front stopping power on your 4th-generation F-Body with the Wilwood DynaPro Radial Front Drag Brake Kit (140-10787). Engineered for high-speed drag racing and heavy street/strip builds, this kit drops significant unsprung rotating weight while fitting inside popular 15" drag wheels.

This kit utilizes radial-mount forged billet 4-piston calipers and heavy-duty 0.81" vented iron rotors, making it the ideal setup for vehicles weighing over 2,800 lbs or high-trap speed setups requiring superior fade resistance and heat capacity over thin solid rotors.

#### What’s Included:

* DynaPro Radial 4-Piston Calipers: Forged billet aluminum radial-mount calipers in durable Type III hard anodize.
* 11.75" x 0.81" Vented Rotors: Plain-face e-coated iron rotors designed to maximize thermal capacity during high-speed stops.
* Billet Aluminum Hubs: Machine-finished hubs with 5x4.75" GM bolt pattern.
* Hardware & Brackets: Radial caliper mounting brackets, wheel bearings, grease seals, dust caps, BP-10 brake pads, and mounting hardware.
